subject: Mythology
title: Japanese Mythology Today
description: Learn Japanese Mythology Today in one minute.

hook.text: Japan is one of the most advanced nations on earth, yet Shinto shrines still bless new cars and computers.

buildup.text: Tech companies hold Shinto purification rituals before launching new products. Robots are blessed at shrines.

discovery.text: Japanese myth says objects gain spirits after 100 years, a belief that shapes how Japan treats old things.

twist.text: KonMari tidying asks if objects 'spark joy' — an idea rooted in the Shinto belief that everything has a spirit.

climax.text: Japanese mythology did not survive despite modernity. It adapted to it, finding new forms in every generation.

punchline.text: In Japan, the future is built on foundations laid by gods who never left.

quiz.question: How does Shinto mythology connect to modern Japanese technology culture?
options: Tech companies reject all religious traditions entirely
Companies hold Shinto purification rituals before product launches and bless devices
Mythology is only preserved in museums and academic settings
